title: Olist Marketplace Orders, Customer Experience, and Marketing Funnel
description: A privacy-reduced relational course release of real anonymized Olist marketplace orders, items, payments, review scores, products, sellers, and marketing leads.

coverage.commerce_period: 2016-09 through 2018-10, with the main order concentration in 2017-2018
coverage.note: The source is a historical anonymized sample, not a current census of Brazilian e-commerce.

join_keys.design_note: Normalized tables are intentionally retained. Students must identify table grain before joining and must prevent repeated order-, payment-, and freight-level values.

sources.name: Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist

course_redactions: all source order, customer, product, seller, review, lead, landing-page, SDR, and sales-representative identifiers
exact geolocation coordinates and full address information
privacy.assessment: Olist describes the source as anonymized. The course release further replaces source identifiers with deterministic release-local keys and retains only city, state, and postal-prefix geography.

restrictions: adaptations must use the same license

artifacts.name: order_items
artifacts.grain: One item sequence within an order

artifacts.name: payments
artifacts.grain: One payment sequence within an order

artifacts.name: reviews
artifacts.grain: One order with aggregated submitted review scores

artifacts.name: order_analysis
artifacts.grain: One order with selected commercial, review, and delivery summaries
